name: search-frontier-v1
question: Which single audit-mapped search extension, if any, improves depth-12 move regret per unit computation?
domain: All 957 candidate turns from the 31 Stockfish-100n losses; development-only
frozen_formula: Locked-3: material + space + tempo with the accepted coefficients and intercept

policies.searched-3-baseline: Forcing/forcing, two internal plies, 128 expansions per legal root
policies.all-captures-2: Checks, promotions, and every capture at both internal plies, 128 expansions per legal root
policies.all-opponent-replies-2: Every opponent reply followed by forcing candidate continuations, 256 expansions per legal root
policies.all-candidate-continuations-2: Forcing opponent replies followed by every candidate continuation, 256 expansions per legal root
policies.forcing-3: Three forcing plies, 256 expansions per legal root

ordering: Accepted forcing ordering first; added moves in UCI lexical order
stand_pat: Allowed at forcing and all-captures nodes when not in check; disallowed at all-legal nodes
oracle: Stockfish 18 depth 12, root-move constrained, one thread, 16 MB hash
metrics: mean, median, p95, and thresholded mover-oriented regret
legal roots and internal expanded states
budget exhaustion and Python wall time
decision: An extension must reduce mean regret by at least 10% and have a 31-game grouped-bootstrap 95% regret-delta interval below zero. Select at most one: lowest mean total states, then lowest regret, then lexical label. Otherwise retain baseline.
guardrail: Development selection only. Any advancing policy requires a frozen new opening-suite confirmation before a playing-strength claim.
